name: stash
description:
Temporary artifact storage for multi-step workflows. Store files, images, JSON, or downloaded data that tools need to share.

Use this when:
- Downloading images/files from URLs for later use
- Storing intermediate data between tool calls
- Preparing artifacts for pdf_create or printer
- Caching API responses or web search results
- SAVING STASH DATA TO MEMORY → use action='remember'

Do NOT use for:
- Permanent memory (user preferences, facts) → use remember tool instead (unless saving stash content)
- Building software → use opencode instead
- One-off text notes → use canvas instead

Workflow patterns:
- stash.save(download URL) → pdf_create(stash files) → printer.print()
- crawl_url → stash.save → stash.remember (save important findings to memory)

Actions:
- open_space: Create/resume a task bucket
- save: Store text, JSON, base64, or download from URL (kind='url')
- list: List files or spaces
- read: Get file content or path
- remember: Save stash artifact to PERMANENT MEMORY (text content or metadata for binary)
- cleanup: Delete expired spaces

Examples:
- 'Download this image' → save with kind='url', url='https://...'
- 'Save that stash data to memory' → remember with search='keyword' or space_id+file_id
- 'What files do I have?' → list
- 'Get that file' → read with file_id

space_id.description: Space ID. Omit for open_space to create new, or for list to show all spaces.

labels.description: Labels/tags for the space (for open_space or update)

kind.description: Content type for save: text, json, base64, or url

url.description: URL to download (for kind=url). Includes SSRF protection.

on_conflict.description: What to do if file exists: error, overwrite, version

file_id.description: File ID or name (for read or remember)

mode.description: Read mode: auto, text, path, metadata

pinned.description: Pin space to prevent auto-deletion (for update)

search.description: Search term to find stash file by name or tags (for remember action, alternative to space_id+file_id)

key.description: Memory key for remember action. Auto-generated from filename if not provided.

summary.description: Custom summary to save instead of full content (for remember action)

summarize.description: Use LLM to intelligently summarize large content instead of truncating (for remember action). Adds ~1-2s latency but preserves key facts. Default: false
